H10-01: Inspection of icon-only buttons for accessible labels or tooltips.
Pass: All icon-only interactive elements possess an accessible label/tooltip.
Fail: An icon-only button lacks a title, aria-label, or corresponding tooltip data.
1. Select button or [role="button"]. Skip if it has visible text content.
2. Check for title, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, or tooltip data-attributes.
3. Check child SVG/IMG for alt, <title>, or aria-label.
If an icon-only button is missing a tooltip or aria-label:
- Add title and aria-label attributes to provide a descriptive text alternative for screen readers and mouse hover interactions.
